hero_sub_html: From your first console.log() to async/await, DOM, APIs and a complete reference manual — 46 lessons across 5 phases, from beginner to confident developer.

about.label: About This Course
paras_html: HTML gives structure, CSS makes it beautiful — JavaScript makes it interactive. It is the programming language of the browser and the most widely used language in the world.

46 lessons across 5 phases covering everything from basic syntax to advanced architecture, real projects, and a complete reference manual. Designed by Babatunde Awoyemi, Techbase Consultant Services, Ibadan.

steps.p_html: This course manipulates HTML. Complete HTML (and ideally CSS) before you start.
Open DevTools (F12) alongside every lesson and run every snippet as you read.
Do not copy-paste. Type every example. Muscle memory is how JavaScript learning sticks.
Lesson 30 has real projects. Lesson 45 is the capstone. Complete every single one.
